item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President reports to Congress that he previously issued an executive order; this segment does not itself expand the emergency or alter legal rights.","evidence":"I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President describes to Congress the legal effects, delegation, and implementation directions contained in a separately issued order and encloses it; this reporting segment itself creates no legal consequence.","evidence":"I am enclosing a copy of the Executive Order I have issued."}]}
